label: Fashion week
description: The event code, such as NYFW or PFW.

label: Event month
description: The month and year of the fashion week event.

label: Title event month
description: The abbreviated event month used in the contract title.

label: Representative name
description: The person representing the participating brand.

label: Brand name
description: The participating brand named in the agreement.

label: Full participation cost
description: The fixed full price for the selected brand category.

label: Grant amount
description: The Fashion Forward Fund discount amount.

label: Remaining balance
description: The full price minus the approved grant amount.

label: Clothing full price
description: The clothing price referenced by the accessory clause.

label: Grant section
description: Shows its content only when a grant is enabled.

label: Accessory clause
description: Shows its content only for accessory-family brands.

label: Payment 2 section
description: Shows its content when a second payment exists.

label: Payment 3 section
description: Shows its content when a third payment exists.
